messages.text: A and I both want the trailer in the next few weeks, and neither of us is backing down. B's pad is where it lives, so she is stuck in the middle. Can you help the three of us sort this out?
I need it for hauling on a home project, and it needs to happen in the next few weeks. What matters most is being able to use it when I need it—not just waiting until A is done.

I don’t have a particular use for it in the next few weeks. I’d prefer it not take up space on my pad, though I know I agreed to keep it here. I’d need my landlord’s approval for any change to what’s stored there, and I haven’t asked him yet.
I want to use it for weekend trips in the next few weeks. What matters most is having the freedom to make plans and use it when I need it.
That’s accurate for me. A calendar could work, but we need to agree on dates soon so I’m not left waiting while A uses it.
My concern is right. I’m open to a shared calendar, but I don’t want a fixed split that blocks my weekend plans; let’s keep it flexible and settle dates soon.
I don’t have dates to suggest; knowing when each pickup is would help me plan. I’d still prefer the trailer not stay on my pad, but I’d need to check with my landlord before changing the arrangement.
Yes, if I propose specific dates soon and we lock them in before A plans the remaining weekends.
I can accept that if C proposes the fixed dates soon and my remaining weekends stay available for flexible use.
Sure, once C proposes the dates, I’ll let them know which work for me. I’ll also get back to you if anything changes.
